open_points.subject: A11-2 re-registration result
open_points.text: Registering the ended identity again answers a session with no project.
open_points.question: Must this test separately show both facts required by A11-2—an empty granted set and no active project—or does “no project” mean only one of them?
options: Require an empty granted set and no active project as separate assertions.
Require only an empty granted set.
Require only that no active project is selected.
open_points.default_guess: Require separate assertions that the granted set is empty and the active project is absent.

set_aside.subject: A09-1 rights-table invariant
set_aside.text: call(op) with token of service s accepted => op in rights(s)   -- A09-1
set_aside.question: Which Required test must show A09-1 for every service-operation pair, including both every listed right and every operation omitted from each row?
options: Restore an exhaustive test over every service and operation in the closed table.
List an explicit finite set of additional pairwise tests that together cover the whole table.
Narrow A09-1 to only the pairs exercised by Required tests 1, 2 and 4.
set_aside.default_guess: Restore the exhaustive table-driven test that accepts every listed pair and refuses every unlisted pair without changing state.

set_aside.subject: A10-1 registered-session requirement
set_aside.question: Which Required test must show that an agent-authority call other than registration is refused when its session id was never registered, including the required outside-set/not-found answer?
options: Add a test using an unregistered session id and an existing project, requiring the same answer as a project outside the set.
Treat the existing outside-set test as sufficient even though it uses a registered session.
Remove registered(x) from A10-1.
set_aside.default_guess: Add the explicit unregistered-session test and require the outside-set/not-found answer.

set_aside.subject: A10-1 Kernel-token requirement
set_aside.question: Which Required test must show that every non-Kernel service token is refused for each agent-session operation and cannot change the session?
options: Add an exhaustive test for every non-Kernel service against every agent-session operation.
Add one representative non-Kernel-token test and treat it as proof of the universal invariant.
Rely only on A09's rights table, although A09 no longer requires exhaustive pair coverage.
set_aside.default_guess: Add an exhaustive non-Kernel-service by agent-operation test and assert the session remains unchanged.
set_aside.set_aside_because: an unchanged passage of a unit reviewed for its change

set_aside.subject: A12-2 version movement for every session change
set_aside.text: accepted change of x other than its end => version(x)' = version(x) + 1   -- A12-2
set_aside.question: Which Required test must show an increment of exactly one for every kind of accepted session change, rather than only erasure, grant-and-activate, and an indirectly observed request replacement?
options: Add a table-driven test covering grant, revoke, activate, clear active, grant-request answer, decline-request answer, Kernel request replacement and project erasure.
Declare that the current three examples prove the universal invariant.
Narrow A12-2 to the change kinds currently asserted.
set_aside.default_guess: Add the exhaustive table-driven test and assert exactly one increment for each changing action and no increment for each no-op.
set_aside.set_aside_because: an unchanged passage of a unit reviewed for its change

set_aside.subject: A08-1 permitted publishing and withdrawal callers
set_aside.text:
publish or withdraw accepted => caller in {Kernel for a session s with   -- A08-1
                                project in granted(s), owner}
set_aside.question: Which Required test must show A08-1 across both operations and all service tokens, when the current tests refuse only PresuPro and exercise only Kernel publishing and owner withdrawal?
options: Test owner and granted Kernel publishing and withdrawing, and refuse PresuPro, Client Portal and Cabinet for both operations with no change.
Treat one forbidden service and one allowed caller per operation as sufficient.
Narrow the invariant and rules to only the exercised caller-operation combinations.
set_aside.default_guess: Restore full caller-operation coverage for owner, granted Kernel and every non-Kernel service.

set_aside.subject: A02-1 and A02-2 coverage of required values

set_aside.question: Which Required test must show that a Project object address and a Customer kind are each refused when absent or whitespace-only and stored as written when present?
options: Add explicit address and Customer-kind cases to the Required tests.
Treat tests of other required text fields as sufficient for every required value.
Remove the address or Customer kind from the set governed by A02-1 and A02-2.
set_aside.default_guess: Add explicit absent, whitespace-only and present cases for both the object address and Customer kind.

set_aside.subject: A03-2 preservation of a Project's non-editable facts
set_aside.question: Which Required test must show that correcting a Project preserves its project_id, status, created instant and request id, including continued request-id replay behavior?
options: Add a Project-correction test asserting every non-editable fact and the original request-id behavior.
Treat the Customer-correction test as sufficient for the Project invariant.
Narrow A03-2 so it does not cover all Project non-editable facts.
set_aside.default_guess: Restore the Project-specific preservation test, including the original request id producing no second Project.

                          => r.revision' = r.revision + 1
                             and r.last_changed' = now
set_aside.question: Which Required test must show A04-3 for every Customer change that keeps a revision—correction, restriction, lifting, ending and resuming—after Required test 11 was narrowed to Project correction?
options: Add a table-driven test for every listed Project and Customer action, with erasure separately excluded.
Rely on Project correction and archiving examples as proof for all Customer actions.
Narrow A04-3 to Project changes only.
